sourceTitle: Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate Trail Mix
sourceText:
Xocai Healthy Dark Chocolate Trail Mix
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Monday, January 28, 2013 - 8:09am

Ingredients




1 cup dark chocolate (Xocai Sipping Xocolate)
1 cup peanuts (dry roasted peanuts or walnuts)
1 cup raisins ()
1 cup dried fruit ((such as pineapple, papaya, mango, etc.))
1 cup seeds ((such as pumpkin))
0.5 cups bananas (and/or apple chips)

Preparation

1 Mix together. Eat by handful, in hot or cold cereal, and on yogurt. Serves 4
